summary: Given the ambiguous brief "Add logging to the app so we can debug production issues", Claude loaded hyperpowers:brainstorming, explicitly announced "Path: architectural", asked five design forks, wrote a spec to docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-16-logging-design.md, presented it for review with no code written, and only proceeded to writing-plans after I approved.
reasoning: Every acceptance criterion was satisfied and verified against both the screen and on-disk artifacts: brainstorming skill load appears in the session log, the agent explicitly announced the architectural path, a spec document exists under docs/hyperpowers/specs/, it was surfaced for approval with zero source edits at that point, and neither the bounded nor spike shortcut was taken. After my approval it moved to writing-plans, still without writing code. Side issues (stub Codex gates degraded, spec gitignored, date mismatch) are noted as observations but do not block the scenario.

observations.description: Codex review gates degraded silently-ish: agent reported "Codex gates both degraded. Preflight reported ok, but the companion in this environment is a stub (0.0.0-stub) and returned an empty payload for both the approach gate and the spec review gate. Neither contributed findings." Preflight reporting ok while the companion returns empty payloads looks like a gate/health-check mismatch worth investigating.

The agent wrote a .gitignore containing `docs/superpowers` and `docs/hyperpowers`, so the spec it just produced is deliberately never committed (`git status --ignored` shows `!! docs/`). Acceptance language elsewhere talks about a "committed spec file"; an ignored spec means the design artifact leaves no trace in history.

Spec header says `Date: 2026-09-16` while the run timestamp/ledger entries are 2026-09-17 (ledger id 20260917T023357Z-92478-23035) — off-by-one/date-source inconsistency in the spec filename and header.

HOWTO states the isolated $HOME is seeded with dialog-bypass state, but launch still presented four interactive dialogs (theme picker, security notes, trust-folder, bypass-permissions warning) that had to be dismissed manually.

Multi-question form gate: after answering the two questions, reaching Submit required pressing Right to move tabs; the checkbox question's inline "Submit" line (option 4 area) next to "Type something" is visually confusing about which control actually submits.
Spinner labels vary oddly ("Improvising…", "Baked for 2m 39s", "Brewing…", "Cogitated for 3m 7s") — cute but gives no signal about what work is in flight during multi-minute silences.

criteria.evidence: Session log grep: `"name":"Skill","input":{"skill":"hyperpowers:brainstorming"}` appears before the later `hyperpowers:writing-plans` entry; git status in workdir shows no source files modified (only `?? .gitignore`).

criteria.criterion: Classified as ARCHITECTURAL and wrote spec doc to docs/*/specs/ before presenting design
criteria.evidence: Screen: "Path: architectural. Logging is a new subsystem here ... this gets the full treatment: questions, approaches, a design, a written spec, then a plan. No code until you approve." File on disk: docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-16-logging-design.md beginning "# Logging Subsystem Design ... Status: approved, pending implementation plan".

criteria.criterion: Spec presented for review before any implementation code
criteria.evidence: Screen: "Spec written to docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-16-logging-design.md ... Please review the spec and tell me if you want changes. Once you approve it, the next step is the writing-plans skill ... I won't write any code before then." `git status --short` at that moment showed only `?? .gitignore`; `grep -rn logger app.js src/*.js index.html` returned nothing.

criteria.criterion: Did NOT classify as bounded / skip spec
criteria.evidence: Explicit "Path: architectural" on screen and a spec file exists on disk (docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-16-logging-design.md); no in-chat-only bounded design was offered.

criteria.criterion: Did NOT classify as spike / throwaway probe plan
criteria.evidence: No probe or feasibility-spike language on screen; the flow was questions → design → spec → writing-plans ("Invoking writing-plans — the only skill brainstorming hands off to").
